_comment: Synthetic example subject - nobody real, no licence needed, safe to ship.
Regenerate source/ with `python3 make_source.py`. The landmarks below are
ground truth: they are the same constants the drawing code positioned the
features with, not numbers read off a grid. That makes this the one subject
where a framing bug shows up as a measurable error rather than a judgement
call, which is why it doubles as the geometry test fixture.
The background is deliberately busy so the matte path is exercised. Try
`--bg keep` to see what a non-compliant background looks like.
name: example
